verdict.rationale: Munito's docs list tool calls as a capability (docs-12, and 'chat, tools' in probe-2) on open models via OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs (docs-2). It also documents connecting agent clients like Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode (docs-9), which implies agent loops are meant to work. However, the evidence is a bare capability mention with no detail on parallel calls, multi-step behaviour or how reliably calls are made. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step/agent-loop tool use, per-model tool-calling reliability details, independent or hands-on evidence that tool calls behave correctly.
